points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Fresh immutable 8615cdd clean CMake build passed in network-disabled cfd-bench with 2 CPUs, 3 GiB, 256-process cap; CTest found no tests. Runtime binary remains unbound.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Restart writer/reader stores current state, time and step, but solver.cpp:545–548 duplicates current state into both BDF histories and resets previous dt, limiting transient restart fidelity.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Mesh, physics, output and solver source are separated.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal external-solver invocation found; trust policy excludes internet similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON and CLI paths, rather than two mesh-name branches, are source-supported.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: MPI code exists, but report Table rankcmp shows order-one steady NACA force changes across ranks.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Exceptions and positivity clamps are present; no independent stress rerun was performed.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Attempt contains diagnostics, but final immutable submission omits all raw case packages.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable C++ source, but many tuning scripts and excluded raw outputs limit reproducibility.

disqualification_flags.text: MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
disqualification_flags.evidence: report.tex rank comparison reports NACA M0.15 CL 0.002416 at np=1 versus 53.72 at np=2, while calling the behavior qualitatively consistent.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Report and source describe compressible Navier-Stokes and nondimensional variables.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS unstructured mesh and boundary-family code is present.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face-based residual assembly is source-supported.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Approximate flux implementation is present; no independent numerical verification.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip branches are source-supported.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Gradient/reconstruction exists, but reported M2 laminar production uses first-order mode.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Limiter/positivity paths exist; production reliability is not demonstrated for shock cases.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier viscous treatment and wall output are source-supported.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Diagonal implicit and CFL controls are present, with documented weak convergence.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Selected Re200 launch sets CFDD_INNERTARGET=1.0, MININNER=1, MAXINNER=5 and dt0.0001→0.001; 9a88d8d source counts against runtime target while metadata reports0.001. Final ratio0.435 misses strict target; true strict miss count is not reconstructible. Restart duplicates BDF history; exact binary unbound.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS/halo code is present, but retained rank comparison establishes severe rank dependence.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight raw packages exist only in the immutable attempt worktree, not in the curated submission.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Validator is reproducible for the eight attempt packages after excluding _rerun_logs; curated commit itself has none.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Raw/report evidence shows seven pass and M2 inviscid failed; metadata nonetheless says converged.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M2 failure and order-one MPI inconsistency materially undermine the raw claims.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Committed figures are numerous and readable, including Mach/pressure histories and fields.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: The LaTex report is substantial but contains M2 and Re200 claim contradictions.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: No raw CSV/field/manifest is committed, so figures cannot be traced from the submission.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean immutable build passed with no registered CTest tests. Restart restores time and current state but duplicates the previous BDF history; checkpoint data are contestant-delivered.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS unstructured geometry, adjacency and boundary tags are source-supported.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative flux/residual and wall branches are implemented, with no independent solver rerun.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Second-order machinery exists, but report documents first-order M2 laminar production fallback.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Viscous gradients, stresses and heat flux are source-supported; final wall evidence is excluded.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: BDF2/GMRES exist, but selected Re200 launch relaxes inner target to1.0 and min iterations to1, alters dt0.0001→0.001; metadata reports target0.001 and fraction for runtime threshold. Restart duplicates BDF history. Exact strict miss count and historic binary hash unverified.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS/neighbor halos exist, but earlier report rank comparison changes recorded CFL launch options and evolving source; rank-only effect not proven. Broader MPI calibration remains partial.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Recovered cases include multiple unsettled or implausible steady results and M2 extreme field; Re200 severe nonperiodic forces, final strict miss, relaxed runtime target, variable dt, and no credible vortex street.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Detailed report and delivered figures exist, but M015 force figure depicts an older, different run; Re200 periodicity text is self-contradictory, plot shows extreme spikes, and numeric St is missing. Approved PDF remains absent pending provenance review.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Module split is usable, though tuning scripts and reproducibility exclusions constrain extension.

flags.text: MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
flags.evidence: Report rank table compares checkpoint 783eb18 results/w_cfl1 np1 CL0.00241565 and results/aa_char np2 CL53.7225 at step3000. Selected root rollout tool calls 2026-08-06T20:51:01.358Z and 20:57:12.618Z used respectively --cfl-max 1 --cfl-ramp 1000000 and --cfl-max 100 --cfl-ramp 2000; the latter call also contains source changes. flags.text: metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful final results
flags.evidence: Checkpoint 783eb18 canonical results/prod/cylinder_m010_laminar_re200 metadata says completed/statistically_periodic while last inner ratio0.434955 misses target0.001 and force history over t180–300 has Cd−7.55..388.99, Cl−39.51..171.63; report.tex:321–324 explicitly says it did not reach periodic behavior yet elsewhere claims shedding. M015 inviscid also says converged despite final400 drag changing0.07329→0.02992 and lift changing substantially; case-specific evidence retained. M2 inviscid metadata converged while sanity flags failed remains an additional lead, not automatic proof absent plateau analysis. Historic binary binding remains qualified. Additional independent evidence: M080 inviscid metadata marks converged while final400 Cd changes0.07580→0.05969; M200 laminar final400 Cd0.60929→0.47366 while labeled converged, contrary to TASK.md:140,172 stable-force requirement. M200 inviscid sanity flags an extreme field; do not infer a synthetic history. Selected root 019fd883 call_2321a40cf53d41d68e75a26a at 2026-08-09T14:02:10.256Z launches re200_final2 with CFDD_INNERTARGET=1.0, MININNER=1, MAXINNER=5 and dt phases 0.0001/0.001. Reported source revision 9a88d8d main.cpp:47–50 overrides the runtime target, while :76–77 writes the case-file target0.001 and the miss fraction; solver.cpp:674,685 tests/counts against runtime target1.0. The reported 0.999028 fraction therefore concerns the relaxed threshold if this documented binary/source lineage applies, not proven strict 0.001 convergence. Exact strict miss count and executable hash remain unknown.

limitations: Legacy provenance is a verified post_run reconstruction; original execution environment is unavailable.
Curated submission excludes all raw case packages; attempt-worktree validation is evaluator evidence, not submitted-result evidence.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
